derivation.derivation: ceil(max(maximum historical writer invocation list cost, maximum historical writer invocation list cost / available completed writer duration * interrupted duration)); USD whole-dollar round-up. Deliberately pairs maximum cost with available completed duration rather than claiming unobserved per-invocation timing. Full largest invocation floor further overcounts the five-minute interruption.
derivation.limitation: Empirical conservative allowance, not recovered exact token usage or a provider-enforced maximum. Older per-invocation timings are unavailable without forbidden transcript/checkpoint access.

infrastructure_waste.reason: Evidenced flat-300s freshness repair deadline bug; founder excludes our infrastructure waste from the case cap.
